clips.title: The story
paras: Skorn Whitecloud is an aging tauren hunter residing at Bloodhoof Village in the rolling plains of Mulgore. He guides young hunters in understanding their relationship with the land's predators and aids travelers who cross paths with Mulgore's lurking dangers.

Living at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud is an old hunter who now serves as an instructor in the ways of the hunt. His primary role is instilling respect for the wild creatures of the plains. He tests aspiring hunters by sending them after the claws of Mulgore's cunning flatland prowlers, to be shown to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, ensuring that those who take up the bow or spear understand the balance between predator and prey.
